51152.note: Family-run country store on a canopy road north of Tallahassee that still makes its sausage and grits on site and sells sausage dogs; a store, not a sit-down restaurant.
51152.fn: Visit Tallahassee says the family store has operated at this same location since 1927; its own site says "since 1927." It is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

51286.note: Lakeside bar and sunset grill on Lake Iamonia north of Tallahassee that grew out of an old bait and tackle shop, with live music.
51286.fn: Began as a bait and tackle shop per Visit Tallahassee; a 2024 Tallahassee Democrat list gave 1951, not otherwise confirmed.
